messages:
maria: deploy-bot flagged preprod promotion as HOLD due to artifact checksum mismatch for webapp-client-2.4.1.tgz. deploy-bot: "verify mismatch expected=3f2a...ac got=7b9d...11 (replica)". thoughts: pin to last-good or reupload?

ian: pulling publish logs now, seeing multipart copy retries on replica-3. origin archive checksum equals expected. looks like replica returned bad range during copy.

jasmin: smoke tests failing with tar: unexpected EOF during extract. that lines up with a truncated mirror copy.

kyle: reupload preserves provenance if we attach a signing note, but we prefer immutable artifacts. pin to last-good to keep change window. create ticket for replication fix.

maria: agree pin last-good to keep the release on schedule. @deploy-bot accept manual approve when I run the command.

deploy-bot: PROMOTE_HOLD reason=artifact-replica-checksum, candidate=7b9d...11, last_verified=3f2a...ac, triggered_by=smoke. awaiting manual_approve from maria.

maria: /deploybot approve promote preprod --sha=3f2a...ac --reason "pin last_verified to avoid changing artifact provenance"

ci-bot: artifact-verify rerun queued (no rebuild). result: byte-range mismatch from replica-3 for ranges 2-4MB. origin matches 3f2a...ac.

ian: opened INF-2487: replica multipart retry + missing post-replication-verify. will add mirror healing job.

jasmin: verification against last-good passed quick smoke. integration flake unrelated.

kyle: notes for release notes: "Preprod promotion pinned to previously verified artifact due to replica copy inconsistency; production artifact contents unchanged; under investigation."

maria: action items: 1) manual promote complete (ian) 2) INF-2487 assigned (ian) 3) add publish pipeline post-replication checksum (jasmin) 4) release note blurb (kyle).

ian: manual promote executed; smoke green; deploy-bot: PROMOTE_COMPLETE preprod -> sha256:3f2a...ac

deploy-bot: PROMOTE_COMPLETE: preprod -> 3f2a...ac

maria: thanks. leaving follow-up to run replica consistency scan for last 24h and schedule brief maintenance if more divergences found.

jasmin: will add a CI regression to fail artifact publish when any replica checksum mismatch detected after copy.

kyle: I'll draft the release note and reference INF-2487. closing thread when ticket is live.
